description: P33 (plan M6-M9 §3.17): at the first shrine of the Old Kingdom - shrines teach talents (talent points, one per level) and offer the ancestry, chosen once. Done when the ancestry is chosen.
text: Shrines of the Old Kingdom shape your blood. Use the shrine ({interact}): the Talents tab spends talent points on lasting talents, and the Ancestry tab lets you choose your ancestry once.
